answer: Persistent Context Carryover: each identity must accumulate a slow-growing history of task outputs before gaining voting weight, like a saffron thread building over seasons. Enforcement: new identities start at zero weight and gain only through verified long-horizon work. An attacker cloning identities pays sustained compute and review attention across many cycles per clone, while a sparrow-sized budget yields negligible influence. This vine of accumulated context is costly to fake at scale.
